review_improvement: Rejects CPU encode-to-null as decoder evidence and makes VP8 identity/evidence independence explicit before the adjacent VP9 case.
independent_technical_reasoning: A decoder consumes a VP8 bitstream; `testsrc` produces raw frames and `libvpx` compresses them on CPU. Sending that encode to null destroys the only candidate bitstream. Consequently no decoder, frame reconstruction or VP8 display path is tested, and VP9 results cannot fill this codec-specific gap.
